key point:
All Markets work on the same principles
Consolidation - Expansion
It is important to identify both.
And after that, there are 5 types of entries for LTF Traders.

1. Anticipation of Expansion
2. During the Expansion
3. Confirmation of Expansion
4. Post-Expansion Pullback
5. HTF Pullback LTF Expansion Confirmation
6. Range play(Ping Pong)

Master 2-3 of them, and you are set.
My Favs are 2, 3, and 4.
1, 5 & 6 are also great, but it is not practically possible to master every kind of entry.

A lot of times, it is also important to understand exactly what type of entry style is working best in a market, or, more importantly, what isn't working that well, and stop doing that until the market favors that entry style again.
